description: THE REFRESH. Recomputes every closed-form published figure that carried the retired q0 = 1.1099785955541805752... at the live muon pin 1.109978595642739046681795129380001752700065561029011556974045769999095 from the canonical q-pinning-50-digit witness. The retired value is the CODATA-2018 vintage of the muon anchor and survives only in fsh-guts/deprecated/computations/; the 2026-08-15 substrate fix reached computations/ and tools/ but not content/. Refreshes per BLOCK, not per figure: an earlier pass substituted only the six sweep-flagged figures and was reverted because each table's other q0-derived rows were never flagged (the sweep looks for figures with NO provenance), leaving a table the reader could not recompute from itself. All seven rows of hecke-log-decomposition move, not the three flagged. Constants (2/(3pi)) and experimental inputs (CODATA 1/alpha, Q_beta^CODATA) are fixed and untouched. Two pre-existing transcription slips surfaced: 1+q0 published 2.10997859556 where the retired pin gives ...555, and log(1/hbar_q) published 2.31181024982 where it gives ...985 -- 1e-11 and 3e-11, wrong at their own anchor and independent of the pin, corrected by construction. Nothing physical moves: q0 shifts 8e-11 relative and the alpha^-1 residual stays at -4.2e-6. E_0, Q_beta and the spectral-bridge quantities are OUT OF SCOPE -- producer outputs whose values also depend on the trace convention, and the qbeta C->D migration is qou-cds1's. qou-i229.
caveats: Closed-form figures ONLY. E_0, Q_beta and the spectral-bridge quantities are producer outputs and convention-dependent; refreshing a pin under a convention that is itself about to change would produce numbers nobody has checked. Those come from their producers.
Constants and experimental inputs are deliberately NOT refreshed: 2/(3pi), CODATA 1/alpha = 137.035999177(21), Q_beta^CODATA. A refresh that moved them would be a different and wrong change.
q0AnchorReason: compares two pins on purpose: the retired CODATA-2018 muon pin 1.10997859555418... and the live muon pin 1.10997859564273...; it recomputes each published figure at both, so no single pin applies
